review_evidence: HexDeterminant/RowOps.lean proves determinant behavior under identity, row/column swap, scaling, addition, and transpose operations.
HexDeterminant/Adjugate.lean defines cofactors and adjugate and proves the associated row-pairing identities.
The repository also develops Leibniz, Cauchy-Binet, Plücker, Gram, minor, triangular, and last-row determinant theory used by the executable verified stack.
summary: Retain hex-determinant as a substantial verified determinant, cofactor, adjugate, minor, and matrix-identity development.
